name: Hundred-Fold Crucible (Bách Luyện Lô)
lore: A small crucible of white clay and silver wire, made by Tưởng Bách Luyện in 980 for the first assay of the house, and used every day since. It is said that no false metal has ever come out of it, and no true one has ever been refused.
build_use: The head's crucible: art damage, spirit sense and a field that burns off false strength.

name: The House Weight (Các Cân)
lore: Chân Kim's copy of the Pivot's standard weight, cast in bronze in 980 and kept on the house's side of the open square at Song Kiều. Đặng Quân Bình of the Pivot has twice found it a hair light, and twice it has been found true when the head weighed it himself. Tưởng Ngọc Cân, the head's granddaughter, keeps it.
build_use: The scale-keeper's seal: status duration and a small thumb on the scale.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Hallmark Seal (Kim Ấn)
lore: The house's assay stamp: a bar of silver it has struck is good in every market from the Pivot to the coast.
build_use: Debuffs that stick to a foe the crucible has tried.

name: Robe of the Refiner (Luyện Kim Bào)
lore: Scorched at the hem by two centuries at the crucible's mouth, mended in silver thread.
build_use: Guard for an assayer who stands close.

name: Counterweight Coin (Đối Trọng Tiền)
lore: A bronze counterweight she cast herself for the house's pan of the scale; set beside the House Weight, the pair reads true whenever the Pivot's assayer tests it.
